boundaries: ILP and Genetic packages retain partial parity statuses. Exact optimizer/search behavior, objective/fitness calculations, conversion conventions, parameter/type/error corpora and all other catalogue gates remain open.
The displayed and exported model is the actual bounded native result, which need not fit every source case. The genetic fixture retains two fitting cases out of three; no perfect-fit claim is made.

Valid custom activity fields follow the model into conformance. Native discovery may fall back when a requested activity field is absent; a selected conformance field must exist. The full missing/partial-field fallback and other selector/normalization conventions remain gates.

Discovery reports insert the original native response JSON verbatim alongside the reviewed request parameters. Browser seeds are capped to the JS exact integer range; native CLI/HTTP controls remain available.

Generator matrix conversion omits empty extended-arc arrays that appear in the ordinary genetic result. Matching actual PNML and markings prove the exercised conversion; schema/type parity remains independent.

The browser error assertion originally assumed absent activity fields were rejected, but the observed native behavior falls back to imported activities. A separate strict timestamp-selector failure is verified. Perfect replay also collapses its variant list; phase field and fitting-count signals are verified instead. Prior records are retained.

No native core algorithm changed. All 167 core objects are verified and reused; the server, CLI and three assertion-enabled suites are freshly compiled. The other catalogue algorithm proofs remain inherited.
Cancellation signals/controls exist; no browser completion or native-computation cancellation result is asserted.
All 86 packages and 387 modules remain in scope, with 46 complete packages, 199 complete modules and 228 incomplete units, without package/module promotion.
No browser cancellation completion is asserted.
The native activity selector can fall back to imported activities when the named field is missing; complete fallback/selector conventions remain parity gates.
Perfect replay collapses its variant list; the selected phase field and fitting counts are the verified replay signals.
